results.heading: MODEL AGREEMENT - INDIA / UNSECURED PERSONAL CREDIT
results.text:
MODEL AGREEMENT - INDIA / UNSECURED PERSONAL CREDIT
PERSONAL LOAN AGREEMENT
Execution date: 15 September 2026 | Place: New Delhi, India | Document ID: TEST-LOAN-2026-001
FICTIONAL TRAINING DOCUMENT. All persons, addresses, figures and facts below are invented for testing a contract-analysis application.
This document has no legal effect, is not issued by any bank, NBFC or government authority, and is not intended as legal advice.
This Personal Loan Agreement ("Loan Agreement") records a fictional unsecured personal loan between the lender and
borrower described below. The commercial terms are intentionally realistic and include several provisions that a clause auditor
may wish to flag for review.
PARTIES AND COMMERCIAL TERMS
Lender Northbridge Capital Services Pvt. Ltd. (fictional), CIN placeholder: TESTCIN000000, New Delhi
Borrower Kunal Verma, age 34, contact: kunal.verma@example.test
Loan Purpose Home relocation and personal expenses; no prohibited end-use represented
Principal INR 8,75,000
Interest 14.75% per annum, fixed for the initial 24 months; subject to Clause 6 thereafter
Tenure 36 monthly instalments commencing 05 October 2026
Processing Fee 2.25% of principal + applicable taxes, deducted from disbursement
Security Unsecured personal loan; no collateral described
Indicative EMI Approximately INR 30,090, subject to actual disbursement date and final amortisation
RECITALS

results.heading: (A) The Borrower has requested a personal loan. (B) The Lender has agreed to make the Principal available subject to the
results.text:
(A) The Borrower has requested a personal loan. (B) The Lender has agreed to make the Principal available subject to the
terms below. (C) The parties wish to document repayment, default, costs, information handling and dispute procedures.

results.heading: 1. Disbursement
results.text:
1. Disbursement
Subject to completion of the Lender's stated documentation and verification requirements, the net disbursement shall be credited to
the Borrower's nominated bank account after deduction of the Processing Fee and any other disclosed deductions. The loan is
deemed disbursed when the Lender issues the transaction confirmation.

results.heading: 2. Repayment
results.text:
2. Repayment
The Borrower shall repay the Principal and applicable interest through 36 monthly instalments. The due date is the 5th calendar day of
each month unless a bank holiday causes processing to occur on the next business day. The Lender may present electronic debit
instructions in accordance with the mandate provided by the Borrower.

results.heading: 3. Application of Payments
results.text:
3. Application of Payments
Unless required otherwise by applicable law, payments may be appropriated first to taxes and costs, then overdue charges and
interest, and finally to principal. A payment received without a written allocation instruction shall be applied using the Lender's
standard servicing waterfall.

results.heading: 4. Processing Fee
results.text:
4. Processing Fee
A Processing Fee equal to 2.25% of the Principal, plus applicable taxes, shall be payable at disbursement and may be deducted from
the gross amount otherwise payable to the Borrower. The fee compensates the Lender for origination and administrative services.

results.heading: 5. Interest Calculation
results.text:
5. Interest Calculation
Interest accrues on the outstanding principal at the stated annual rate using the Lender's standard daily accrual convention and actual
days elapsed. The amortisation schedule supplied after disbursement shall show the instalment breakdown between principal and
interest.

results.heading: 6. Rate Review After Initial Period
results.text:
6. Rate Review After Initial Period
After the first 24 months, the Lender may revise the interest rate once by up to 2.50 percentage points per annum where there is a
documented change in the Borrower's credit risk or in the Lender's funding benchmark. The revised rate shall be notified at least 15
days before the revised rate takes effect.
TEST FLAG: Rate-change discretion is capped but still depends on broad credit-risk/funding language.

results.heading: 7. Late Charges
results.text:
7. Late Charges
For any instalment not paid by the due date, the Borrower shall pay a late charge of 2% per month on the overdue instalment amount,
calculated for the period of delay, together with applicable taxes if lawfully chargeable. A late charge does not relieve the Borrower
from the underlying instalment obligation.
TEST FLAG: High recurring late-charge language; useful as a risk/consumer-fairness test case.

results.heading: 8. Prepayment and Foreclosure
results.text:
8. Prepayment and Foreclosure
The Borrower may request part-prepayment or full foreclosure. Unless a lower fee is required by applicable regulation or specifically
waived in writing, the Lender may charge 5% of the prepaid principal for full or partial prepayment before completion of 12 months,
plus applicable taxes and documented third-party charges.

results.heading: 9. Statements and Records
results.text:
9. Statements and Records
The Lender may provide electronic account statements. Unless the Borrower disputes a statement within 30 days of receipt, the
statement shall be treated as accepted for routine servicing purposes, without limiting rights that cannot lawfully be waived.

results.heading: 10. Auto-Debit Mandate
results.text:
10. Auto-Debit Mandate
The Borrower authorises the Lender to submit repayment instructions under the electronic mandate supplied. If a debit is returned
unpaid, the Borrower shall reimburse any bank or network charges actually imposed, subject to applicable law.
AUDITOR ATTENTION
The next page contains deliberately strong default, cross-default, indemnity and information-sharing provisions. These are written to resemble
real commercial drafting while remaining synthetic.

results.heading: 11. Events of Default
results.text:
11. Events of Default
An Event of Default occurs if the Borrower fails to pay an amount for 10 days after written demand; materially breaches this
Agreement; provides materially false information; becomes subject to insolvency proceedings; or materially defaults on another
financial obligation where that default is reasonably likely to affect repayment capacity.

results.heading: 12. Acceleration
results.text:
12. Acceleration
Following an Event of Default, and subject to any mandatory notice or cure period, the Lender may declare all outstanding Principal,
accrued interest and contractually due charges immediately payable. The Borrower shall also reimburse reasonable enforcement
costs to the extent permitted by law.
TEST FLAG: Acceleration creates a large immediate payment obligation; useful as a high-severity flag.

results.heading: 13. Cross-Default
results.text:
13. Cross-Default
A default under another loan, credit card, guarantee or material financial commitment may be treated as an Event of Default under this
Agreement if the Lender reasonably believes the other default creates a material risk to repayment.
TEST FLAG: Broad cross-default wording; trigger is based on the Lender's belief rather than an objective threshold.

results.heading: 14. Set-Off
results.text:
14. Set-Off
To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Lender may set off matured amounts due under this Agreement against credit balances
or amounts otherwise payable by the Lender to the Borrower, after giving notice of the exercise of set-off.

findings.message: Money in your other accounts with this lender can be applied to this loan. Check whether notice is required first and whether it is limited to amounts already due.

results.heading: 15. Indemnity
results.text:
15. Indemnity
The Borrower shall indemnify the Lender against direct losses, reasonable professional expenses and third-party claims arising from
the Borrower's fraud, wilful misconduct, material misrepresentation or breach of the Agreement, except to the extent caused by the
Lender's own unlawful conduct or negligence where such exclusion is required by law.
TEST FLAG: Broad reimbursement language; useful for testing scope and carve-outs.

results.heading: 16. Information and Sharing
results.text:
16. Information and Sharing
The Borrower authorises the Lender to collect, retain, verify and process information necessary to administer the loan and to share
relevant information with service providers, credit-information agencies, insurers, auditors, collection vendors, affiliates and
prospective assignees, subject to applicable law and stated privacy practices.
TEST FLAG: Wide recipient list and broad purpose language; useful privacy-consent flag.

results.heading: 17. Assignment
results.text:
17. Assignment
The Lender may assign, transfer or participate its rights under this Agreement to an affiliate, financial institution, securitisation vehicle
or other permitted transferee, subject to applicable law. The Borrower may not assign the Borrower's obligations without the Lender's
written consent.

findings.message: The loan can be sold on to someone else without telling you.

results.heading: 18. Change in Contact Details
results.text:
18. Change in Contact Details
The Borrower shall notify the Lender within seven days of a change in postal address, email address, mobile number or employment
status. Notices sent to the most recently notified contact details shall be treated as delivered in accordance with applicable law.

results.heading: 19. Fees and Other Costs
results.text:
19. Fees and Other Costs
The Borrower shall pay applicable statutory charges, taxes and third-party costs expressly identified in the tariff, schedule or account
statement. No fee may be imposed if prohibited by law or if disclosure is legally required but was not made.
TEST FLAG: The phrase "third-party costs" is intentionally broad for audit testing.

results.heading: 20. Waiver
results.text:
20. Waiver
Failure or delay by the Lender to exercise a right shall not operate as a waiver of that right. Any waiver shall be effective only if
recorded in writing for the specific instance stated.

results.heading: 21. Notices
results.text:
21. Notices
Notices may be delivered by email, SMS alert, courier, registered post or other legally recognised electronic means to the latest
contact details provided by the Borrower. A notice is deemed received according to applicable law or, where law is silent, on the next
business day after transmission without a delivery failure notice.

results.heading: 22. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
results.text:
22. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. Subject to mandatory statutory forums and remedies, disputes may be brought
before courts and tribunals having lawful jurisdiction over the Lender's principal office or the Borrower's residence, as applicable.
TEST FLAG: Non-exclusive and dual-location forum wording can create interpretive issues.

results.heading: 23. Severability
results.text:
23. Severability
If any provision is held invalid, illegal or unenforceable, it shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary or severed, and the
remainder shall continue in effect.

results.heading: 24. Entire Agreement and Amendments
results.text:
24. Entire Agreement and Amendments
This Agreement, the final repayment schedule and any expressly incorporated application or disclosure form constitute the
understanding between the parties regarding the Loan. An amendment that materially changes a financial obligation should be
documented in a form permitted by applicable law.

results.heading: 25. Regulatory Compliance
results.text:
25. Regulatory Compliance
The Lender and Borrower shall each comply with applicable laws, regulatory directions and court orders affecting performance of this
Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement is intended to waive any mandatory statutory consumer, privacy, banking or dispute-resolution
right.
SCHEDULE 1 - ILLUSTRATIVE REPAYMENT SNAPSHOT
Gross Principal INR 8,75,000
Illustrative Processing Fee INR 19,687.50 plus applicable taxes
Illustrative Tenure 36 months
Illustrative Rate 14.75% p.a. for first 24 months; thereafter subject to Clause 6
Illustrative EMI About INR 30,090, to be confirmed in the final schedule
Illustrative Total Scheduled Approximately INR 10.83 lakh before any optional prepayments, late charges or rate review effects
Payments
SIGNATURES
LENDER - AUTHORISED SIGNATORY BORROWER
Ananya Rao, fictional signatory Kunal Verma
Signature: __________________________ Signature: __________________________
Date: ______________________________ Date: ______________________________
